mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months and SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals economic weakness and potential earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: Joint strength in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) indicates robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000 and SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to impending monetary tightening and profit margin pressures, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 annual growth rate > 2% and SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: When 12-month CPI inflation exceeds 2.0%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.0% and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 4.5%) indicate robust economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 4.5% and SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion (INDPRO annual growth > 1.5%), improving manufacturing activity and economic momentum fuel S&P 500 rallies, producing positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO annual growth rate > 1.5% and SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of such periods

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signal strong residential demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 and SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of such periods
